articles.summary: Rio Tinto Group is back in focus after analysts adjusted their price targets around a slightly higher fair value estimate of £76.98, up from £75.37. articles.title: Rio Tinto Group (LSE:RIO) Commits $250 Million To Panguna Mine Remediation
articles.summary: Rio Tinto Group (LSE:RIO) has agreed to commit $250 million toward addressing legacy impacts at the Panguna mine in Bougainville. The funding is earmarked for environmental clean up, social programs, and human rights remediation linked to the former copper gold operation. The voluntary commitment follows earlier assessment work on Panguna's legacy issues and moves the process into an active remediation phase. articles.title: Rio Tinto Group (LSE:RIO) Restarts Tiwai Point Capacity, Is The Valuation Gap Too Wide?
articles.summary: Rio Tinto Group (LSE:RIO) is back in the headlines after agreeing a three and a half year, 50MW electricity deal that will restart Line 4 at New Zealand’s Tiwai Point aluminium smelter, restoring full capacity.
